G3000.strongs: to minister (to God), i.e. render religious homage
senses: to serve; in cl., also of divine service, to serve, worship, and so always in NT: with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, [[r:MAT.4.10|Mat 4:10]], [[r:LUK.4.8|Luk 4:8]]" (LXX), [[r:ACT.7.7|Act 7:7 24:14 27:23]], [[r:HEB.9.14|Heb 9:14]], [[r:REV.7.15|Rev 7:15 22:3]]; of idol worship (cf. [[r:EXO.20.5|Exo 20:5]], [[r:EZK.20.32|Eze 20:32]]), [[r:ACT.7.42|Act 7:42]], [[r:ROM.1.25|Rom 1:25]]; τ. θεῷ. ἐν τ. πνεύματί μου, [[r:ROM.1.9|Rom 1:9]]; id. ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει, [[r:2TI.1.3|2Ti 1:3]]; μετ᾽ εὐλαβείας κ. δέους, [[r:HEB.12.28|Heb 12:28]]; ἐν ὁσιότητι κ. δικαιοσύνῃ, [[r:LUK.1.74|Luk 1:74]]; (without θεῷ) νηστείαις κ. δεήσεσι, [[r:LUK.2.37|Luk 2:37]]; πνεύματι θεοῦ, [[r:PHP.3.3|Php 3:3]]; absol., [[r:ACT.26.7|Act 26:7]]; ὁ λατρεύων, the worshipper, [[r:HEB.9.9|Heb 9:9 10:2]]; of ministerial service, with dative of thing(s), [[r:HEB.8.5|Heb 8:5 13:10]].† SYN.: λειτουργέω, q.v (AS)
(λαχαίνω, to dig), a garden herb, vegetable: [[r:LUK.11.42|Luk 11:42]]; usually in pl., [[r:MAT.13.32|Mat 13:32]], [[r:MRK.4.32|Mrk 4:32]], [[r:ROM.14.2|Rom 14:2]].† SYN.: βοτάνη, q.v (AS)

G3004.strongs: properly, to "lay" forth, i.e. (figuratively) relate (in words (usually of systematic or set discourse; whereas and generally refer to an individual expression or speech respectively; while is properly to break silence merely, and means an extended or random harangue)); by implication, to mean
G3004.kjv: ask, bid, boast, call, describe, give out, name, put forth, say(-ing, on), shew, speak, tell, utter
senses: in Hom., to pick out, gather, reckon, recount.

In Hdt. and Att., to say, speak, affirm, declare: absol., [[r:ACT.13.15|Act 13:15, 24:10]]; before orat. dir., [[r:MAT.9.34|Mat 9:34]], [[r:MRK.3.11|Mrk 3:11]], [[r:JHN.1.29|Jhn 1:29]], al.; before ὅτι recit., [[r:MRK.3.21|Mrk 3:21]], [[r:LUK.1.24|Luk 1:24]], [[r:JHN.6.14|Jhn 6:14]], al.; accusative and inf., [[r:LUK.11.18|Luk 11:18]], [[r:JHN.12.29|Jhn 12:29]], al.; after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, [[r:MAT.11.17|Mat 11:17]], al.; ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, Words, 24 ff.), [[r:MAT.25.9|Mat 25:9]], [[r:MRK.3.33|Mrk 3:33, 7:28]], [[r:LUK.24.6|Luk 24:6]], 7, al.; of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, [[r:MAT.3.9|Mat 3:9]], [[r:LUK.3.8|Luk 3:8]], al.; of writing, [[r:2CO.8.8|2Co 8:8]], [[r:PHP.4.11|Php 4:11]], al.; λέγει ἡ γραφή, [[r:ROM.4.3|Rom 4:3]], [[r:JAS.2.23|Jas 2:23]], al.; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:LUK.8.8|Luk 8:8, 9:33]], [[r:JHN.5.34|Jhn 5:34]], al.; σὺ λέγεις (a non-committal phrase; Swete, Mk., 359, 369f.), [[r:MAT.27.11|Mat 27:11]], [[r:MRK.15.2|Mrk 15:2]], [[r:LUK.23.3|Luk 23:3]], [[r:JHN.18.37|Jhn 18:37]]; with dative of person(s), before orat. dir., [[r:MAT.8.20|Mat 8:20]], [[r:MRK.2.17|Mrk 2:17]], al. mult.; id. before ὅτι, [[r:MAT.3.9|Mat 3:9]], al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, etc., [[r:MRK.4.41|Mrk 4:41]], [[r:JHN.11.56|Jhn 11:56]], [[r:HEB.9.5|Heb 9:5]], al.; to mean (cl.), [[r:MRK.14.71|Mrk 14:71]], [[r:JHN.6.71|Jhn 6:71]], [[r:1CO.10.29|1Co 10:29]], al.; to call, name, [[r:MRK.10.18|Mrk 10:18]]; pass., [[r:MAT.9.9|Mat 9:9]], [[r:MRK.15.7|Mrk 15:7]], al (cf. ἀντι-, δια- (-μαι), προ-, συλ-λέγω). SYN.: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr., Syn., Ixxvi; Thayer, see word λαλέω). (AS)

G3005.forms: λεῖμμα (WH, λίμμα, see their App., 154), -τος, τό

G3007.strongs: to leave, i.e. (intransitively or passively) to fail or be absent
senses: trans., to leave, leave behind; pass., to be left behind, to lack before prep. (as more usual in cl.), ἐν, [[r:JAS.1.4|Jas 1:4]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:JAS.1.5|Jas 1:5 2:15]].

Intrans., to be gone, to be wanting: with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.18.22|Luk 18:22]], [[r:TIT.3.13|Tit 3:13]]; τὰ λείποντα, [[r:TIT.1.5|Tit 1:5]] (cf. ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, ἐν-κατα-, περι-, ὑπο-λείπω).† (AS)

G3008.strongs: to be a public servant, i.e. (by analogy) to perform religious or charitable functions (worship, obey, relieve)
senses: in cl., at Athens, to supply public offices at one's own cost, render public service to the State, hence, generally,

to serve the State, do a service, serve (of service to the Gods, Diod., i, 21): of the official service of priests and Levites ([[r:EXO.29.30|Exo 29:30]], [[r:NUM.16.9|Num 16:9]], [[r:SIR.4.14|Sir 4:14]], [[r:1MA.10.42|1Ma 10:42]], al.; cf. Deiss., BS, 140 f.), [[r:HEB.10.11|Heb 10:11]]; of Christians: with dative of person(s) before ἐν, [[r:ROM.15.27|Rom 15:27]] (cf. [[r:SIR.10.25|Sir 10:25]]); τ. κυρίῳ, [[r:ACT.13.2|Act 13:2.]]† SYN.: λατρεύω (which see), prop., to serve for hire, LXX (as some­times in cl.), always of service to the deity on the part of both priests and people ([[r:EXO.4.3|Exo 4:3]], [[r:DEU.10.12|Deu 10:12]], and similarly in NT). λειτουργέω "is the fulfilment of an office: it has a definite representative character, and corresponds with a function to be discharged". It is therefore used of serving in an office or ministry: in LXX always of priests and Levites, in NT, with its cognates ([[r:ROM.13.6|Rom 13:6 15:27]], are not really exceptions), of services rendered either to God or man by apostles, prophets, teachers, and other officers of the church (cf. Tr., Syn., § xxxv; ICC on [[r:ROM.1.9|Rom 1:9]]; Westc., He., 232 ff.) (AS)
in cl. (chiefly of Athens), the discharge of a public office at one's own expense (see LS, see word), hence,

a service, ministry; in π. (Deiss., BS, 140 f.) and in LXX (though here also of secular service, [[r:1KI.1.4|3Ki 1:4]], al.), of religious service or ministration; and so in NT: of priestly ministrations, [[r:LUK.1.23|Luk 1:23]], [[r:HEB.8.6|Heb 8:6 9:21]]; figuratively, θυσία καὶ λ. τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν, [[r:PHP.2.17|Php 2:17]]; of Christian beneficence, [[r:2CO.9.12|2Co 9:12]], [[r:PHP.2.30|Php 2:30]].† (AS)

G3011.strongs: a public servant, i.e. a functionary in the Temple or Gospel, or (genitive case) a worshipper (of God) or benefactor (of man)
senses: in cl., one who discharges a public office at his own expense, then, generally,

a public servant, a minister, servant: τ. ἁγίων λ., [[r:HEB.8.2|Heb 8:2]] (cf. [[r:NEH.10.39|Neh 10:39]], Sir, l.with); Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, [[r:ROM.15.16|Rom 15:16]]; pl., τ. θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.13.6|Rom 13:6]], [[r:HEB.1.7|Heb 1:7]]" (LXX); λ. ὑμῶν τ. χρείας μου, [[r:PHP.2.25|Php 2:25.]]† SYN.: see: διάκονος, λειτουργέω (AS)

leprous; chiefly as subst., ὁ λ., a leper: [[r:MAT.8.2|Mat 8:2 10:8 11:5]], [[r:MRK.1.40|Mrk 1:40]], [[r:LUK.4.27|Luk 4:27 7:22 17:12]]; of Simon, formerly a leper, [[r:MAT.26.6|Mat 26:6]], [[r:MRK.14.3|Mrk 14:3]].† (AS)

G3016.root: neuter of a derivative of the same as [[w:G3013]]
G3016.strongs: something scaled (light), i.e. a small coin
senses: fine, thin, small, light; hence, in late Gk., as subst. τὸ λ., a small coin (one-eighth of an as, AV, mite): [[r:MRK.12.42|Mrk 12:42]], [[r:LUK.12.59|Luk 12:59 21:2]].† (AS)

G3017.strongs: Levi, the name of three Israelites
senses: Λευεί (indecl.) and Λευείς (Rec. -υΐ, -υΐς), genitive Λευεί, accusative -είν, ὁ (Heb. H3878) Levi;
Λευεί (indecl.) and Λευείς (Rec. -υΐ, -υΐς), genitive Λευεί, accusative -είν, ὁ (Heb. H3878) Levi;

G3019.strongs: a Levite, i.e. descendant of Levi

G3020.strongs: Levitic, i.e. relating to the Levites

senses: (λευκός), to whiten, make white: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MRK.9.3|Mrk 9:3]], [[r:REV.7.14|Rev 7:14]].† (AS)
λευκο-βύσσινος, -ον (cf. λευκολινής, a robe of white flax, C.I., 155, 17), white linen: [[r:REV.19.14|Rev 19:14]] (WH, mg.).† λευκός, ή, -όν
white: [[r:MAT.5.36|Mat 5:36]], [[r:REV.1.14|Rev 1:14 2:17 4:4 6:2 14:14 19:11]]; figuratively, of garments, [[r:REV.3.18|Rev 3:18]]; of ripened grain, [[r:JHN.4.35|Jhn 4:35.]]† (AS)
(λήθω = λανθάνω) forgetfulness: λ. λαβεῖν (on the phrase, see Mayor, in l): [[r:2PE.1.9|2Pe 1:9.]]† (AS)

(in some MSS., LXX and NT, ὁ), a trough or vat; esp. for the treading of grapes: [[r:MAT.21.33|Mat 21:33]], [[r:REV.14.20|Rev 14:20 19:16]]; τὴν λ.... τὸν μέγαν (a solecism perhaps inadvertent), [[r:REV.14.19|Rev 14:19]] (cf. ὑπολήνιον).† (AS)
λῆμψις (Rec. λῆψις, so in cl.), -εως, ἡ (λαμβάνω), receiving: δόσις καὶ λ., [[r:PHP.4.15|Php 4:15.]]† (AS)

adv. very, exceedingly: [[r:MAT.2.16|Mat 2:16 4:8 8:28 27:14]] [[r:MRK.1.35|Mrk 1:35 6:51]] (Rec. λ. ἐκ περισσοῦ) [[r:MRK.9.3|Mrk 9:3 16:2]], [[r:LUK.23.8|Luk 23:8]], [[r:2TI.4.15|2Ti 4:15]], II Jn 4, 3Jn 3 (cf. ὑτερλίαν).† (AS)

G3030.strongs: the incense-tree, i.e. (by implication) incense itself
senses: (rarely ἡ), (from the Semitic; cf. the Heb. equiv.),

G3031.strongs: frankincense, i.e. (by extension) a censer for burning it
senses: in cl. (and LXX), frankincense, the gum of the libanus.
= Late Gk., λιβανωτρίς, a censer: [[r:REV.8.3|Rev 8:3]], 5 (the same form appears in Inscr.; MM, xvi).† (AS)
Λιβερῖτνος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. libertinus), a freedman: ἡ συναγωγὴ ἡ λεγομένη Λιβερτίνων [[r:ACT.6.9|Act 6:9]] (Bl. thinks the original reading was Λιβυστίνων, Phil. Gosp., 69 f.).† (AS)
Libya, the north part of Africa west of Egypt, (Odyssey by Homer); in later writers also for the whole Continent (ML)

= λιθοβολέω (LXX, NT), to pelt with stones, to stone: with accusative of person(s), [[r:JHN.8.6|Jhn 8:6 10:31-31 11:8]], [[r:ACT.14.10|Act 14:10]]; pass., [[r:ACT.5.26|Act 5:26]], [[r:2CO.11.25|2Co 11:25]], [[r:HEB.11.37|Heb 11:37]] (see DB, Art., " Crimes and punish­ments," and cf. κατα-λιθάζω).† (AS)

λιθο-βολέω, -ῶ (λίθος, βάλλω), to pelt with stones, to kill by stoning, to stone (cf. λιθάζω): with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.21.35|Mat 21:35 23:37]], [[r:LUK.13.34|Luk 13:34]] [[r:ACT.7.58|Act 7:58-59 14:5]]; pass., [[r:HEB.12.20|Heb 12:20]] (LXX).† (AS)

(and, in Att.., of precious stones, ἡ.) a stone: [[r:MAT.4.6|Mat 4:6]], al.; pl., [[r:MAT.3.9|Mat 3:9]], al.; at the entrance of a tomb, [[r:MAT.27.60|Mat 27:60, 66 28:2]], [[r:MRK.15.46|Mrk 15:46 16:3-4]], [[r:LUK.24.2|Luk 24:2]], [[r:JHN.11.38|Jhn 11:38, 32 11:41 20:1]]; λ. μυλικός, [[r:LUK.17.2|Luk 17:2]], cf. [[r:REV.18.21|Rev 18:21]]; of building stones, [[r:MAT.21.42|Mat 21:42]],, [[r:MAT.24.2|Mat 24:2]], [[r:MRK.12.10|Mrk 12:10 13:1-2]], [[r:LUK.19.44|Luk 19:44 20:17-18 21:5-6]] [[r:ACT.4.11|Act 4:11]], [[r:1PE.2.7|1Pe 2:7]]; metaphorically, of Christ, λ. ἀκρογωναῖος, ἐκλεκτός, ἔντιμος, [[r:1PE.2.6|1Pe 2:6]] (LXX); λ. ζῶν, [[r:1PE.2.4|1Pe 2:4]]; προσκόμματος, [[r:1PE.2.8|1Pe 2:8]], [[r:ROM.9.33|Rom 9:33]]; of Christians, λ. ζῶντες, [[r:1PE.2.5|1Pe 2:5]]; of precious stones, λ. τίμιος, [[r:REV.17.4|Rev 17:4 18:12, 16 21:11, 19]]; ἴασπις, [[r:REV.4.3|Rev 4:3]]; ἐνδεδυμένοι λ. καθαρόν, [[r:REV.15.6|Rev 15:6]] (λίνον, Rec., R, mg., see Swete, in l); metaphorically, λ. τίμιοι, [[r:1CO.3.12|1Co 3:12]]; of the tables of the law, [[r:2CO.3.7|2Co 3:7]]; of idols, [[r:ACT.17.29|Act 17:29]] (AS)

G3038.strongs: stone-strewed, i.e. a tessellated mosaic on which the Roman tribunal was placed
senses: λιθό-στρωτος, -ον (στρώννυμι), paved with stones, esp. of tessallated work (Ca, i.e.); as subst., τὸ λ., a tessallated pavement: [[r:JHN.19.13|Jhn 19:13]] (cf. Γαββαθᾶ).† (AS)

G3039.root: from λικμός, the equivalent of λίκνον (a winnowing fan or basket)
G3039.strongs: to winnow, i.e. (by analogy), to triturate
senses: in cl., to winnow (so Ru, l.with).

In LXX (ll with, exc. Ru), to scatter (as chaff or dust): [[r:LUK.20.18|Luk 20:18]] (RV, scatter as dust, Deiss., BS, 225 f., quotes ex. in π. which suggests the meaning ruin, destroy; cf. Vg. comminuet, AV, grind to powder; cf. also Kennedy, Sources, 126), [[r:MAT.21.44|Mat 21:44]], R, txt.† (AS)

G3041.root: probably from [[w:G3040]] (through the idea of nearness of shore)
senses: a lake: of the Sea of Galilee (Mt, Mk, see: θάλασσα), [[r:LUK.5.2|Luk 5:2 8:22-23, 33]]; λ. Γεννησαρέτ (which see), [[r:LUK.5.1|Luk 5:1]]; λ. τ. πυρός, [[r:REV.19.20|Rev 19:20 20:10, 14-15]]; καιομένη πυρί, [[r:REV.21.8|Rev 21:8.]]† (AS)

G3042.root: probably from [[w:G3007]] (through the idea of destitution)

senses: linen: [[r:REV.15.6|Rev 15:6]] (R, mg., see: λίθος).† λίθος, -ου, ὁ (and, in Att.., of precious stones, ἡ.) a stone: [[r:MAT.4.6|Mat 4:6]], al.; pl., [[r:MAT.3.9|Mat 3:9]], al.; at the entrance of a tomb, [[r:MAT.27.60|Mat 27:60, 66 28:2]], [[r:MRK.15.46|Mrk 15:46 16:3-4]], [[r:LUK.24.2|Luk 24:2]], [[r:JHN.11.38|Jhn 11:38, 32 11:41 20:1]]; λ. μυλικός, [[r:LUK.17.2|Luk 17:2]], cf. [[r:REV.18.21|Rev 18:21]]; of building stones, [[r:MAT.21.42|Mat 21:42]],, [[r:MAT.24.2|Mat 24:2]], [[r:MRK.12.10|Mrk 12:10 13:1-2]], [[r:LUK.19.44|Luk 19:44 20:17-18 21:5-6]] [[r:ACT.4.11|Act 4:11]], [[r:1PE.2.7|1Pe 2:7]]; metaphorically, of Christ, λ. ἀκρογωναῖος, ἐκλεκτός, ἔντιμος, [[r:1PE.2.6|1Pe 2:6]] (LXX); λ. ζῶν, [[r:1PE.2.4|1Pe 2:4]]; προσκόμματος, [[r:1PE.2.8|1Pe 2:8]], [[r:ROM.9.33|Rom 9:33]]; of Christians, λ. ζῶντες, [[r:1PE.2.5|1Pe 2:5]]; of precious stones, λ. τίμιος, [[r:REV.17.4|Rev 17:4 18:12, 16 21:11, 19]]; ἴασπις, [[r:REV.4.3|Rev 4:3]]; ἐνδεδυμένοι λ. καθαρόν, [[r:REV.15.6|Rev 15:6]] (λίνον, Rec., R, mg., see Swete, in l); metaphorically, λ. τίμιοι, [[r:1CO.3.12|1Co 3:12]]; of the tables of the law, [[r:2CO.3.7|2Co 3:7]]; of idols, [[r:ACT.17.29|Act 17:29]] (AS)

1. Linos , a mythical minstrel, son of Apollo and Urania (Calliope), teacher of Orpheus, (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus), etc. 2. as appellative, the song or lay of Linos , sung by a boy to the cithara while the vintagers are at work, Λίνον ὑπὸ καλὸν ἄειδεν sang the lovely lay of Linos in accompaniment, (Iliad by Homer):—;compare αἴλινος which is a mournful song. (ML)
(λίπος, fat), oily, fatty; metaphorically, of living, rich, dainty: τὰ λ. καὶ τ. λαμπρά, [[r:REV.18.14|Rev 18:14.]]† (AS)
a Sicilian coin = Rom. libra or as.

G3047.strongs: the south(- west) wind (as bringing rain, i.e. (by extension) the south quarter)
senses: the SW. wind: βλέποντα κατὰ λ., [[r:ACT.27.12|Act 27:12]] (see Page, in l; Deiss., ES, 141).† (AS)
(prop., -εία, see BS, 142 ff.), -ας, ἡ (λογεύω, to collect, a word found in π., see Deiss., BS, l.with; LAE, 70, 103; MM, xvi), a collection: [[r:1CO.16.1|1Co 16:1-2.]]† (AS)

G3049.strongs: to take an inventory, i.e. estimate (literally or figuratively)
G3049.kjv: conclude, (ac-)count (of), + despise, esteem, impute, lay, number, reason, reckon, suppose, think (on)
senses: prop., of numerical calculation, to count, reckon: with accusative before μετά, [[r:MRK.15.23|Mrk 15:23]] (LXX) (Rec., R, mg.), [[r:LUK.22.37|Luk 22:37.]]
Metaphorical, without reference to numbers, by a reckoning of characteristics or reasons;

to reckon, take into account: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:1CO.13.5|1Co 13:5]]; id. before dative of person(s), [[r:ROM.4.3|Rom 4:3]] (LXX), [[r:ROM.4.4|Rom 4:4, 6 4:8]]" (LXX), [[r:2CO.5.19|2Co 5:19]], [[r:2TI.4.16|2Ti 4:16]]; before εἰς (cf. Heb. ל חָשַׁב; Bl., § 33, 3), [[r:ACT.19.27|Act 19:27]], [[r:ROM.2.26|Rom 2:26 4:3, 5 4:9-11, 22-24 9:8]] [[r:GAL.3.6|Gal 3:6]]" (LXX), [[r:JAS.2.23|Jas 2:23]] (LXX);

to consider, calculate: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:PHP.4.8|Php 4:8]]; before ὅτι, [[r:JHN.11.50|Jhn 11:50]], [[r:HEB.11.10|Heb 11:10]]; τοῦτο, ὅτι, [[r:2CO.10.11|2Co 10:11]]; with accusative of person(s), with inf., [[r:ROM.6.11|Rom 6:11]]; before ὡς, [[r:ROM.8.36|Rom 8:36]] (LXX); (with) to suppose, judge, deem: [[r:1CO.13.11|1Co 13:11]]; ὡς, [[r:1PE.5.12|1Pe 5:12]]; οὕτως, [[r:1CO.4.1|1Co 4:1]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:2CO.3.5|2Co 3:5]]; id. before εἰς, [[r:2CO.12.6|2Co 12:6]]; ὅτι, [[r:ROM.8.18|Rom 8:18]]; τοῦτο, ὅτι, [[r:ROM.2.3|Rom 2:3]], [[r:2CO.10.7|2Co 10:7]]; with inf., [[r:2CO.11.5|2Co 11:5]]; accusative and inf., [[r:ROM.3.28|Rom 3:28 14:14]], [[r:PHP.3.13|Php 3:13]]; with accusative of person(s) before ὡς, [[r:2CO.10.2|2Co 10:2]];
to purpose, decide: with inf. (Eur., Or., 555), [[r:2CO.10.2|2Co 10:2]] (cf. ἀνα-, δια-, παρα-, συλ-λογίζομαι).† (AS)

(λόγος, reason) reasonable, rational: λατρεία, [[r:ROM.12.1|Rom 12:1]]; τὸ λ. (i.e. spiritual) γάλα (see Hort, in l; MM, xvi), [[r:1PE.2.2|1Pe 2:2]] (in support of AV, milk of the word, see ICC, in l).† (AS)

(dimin. of λόγος, see ICC, Ro., 70), an oracle: [[r:ACT.7.38|Act 7:38]], [[r:ROM.3.2|Rom 3:2]], [[r:HEB.5.12|Heb 5:12]], [[r:1PE.4.11|1Pe 4:11]] (on the eccl., λόγια τ. Κυρίου, see Lft., Essay on Sup. Rel., 172 ff.).† (AS)
in cl., learned (Ac, l.with, R, txt.).
In late Gk., eloquent: [[r:ACT.18.24|Act 18:24]] (see Page, in l; Field, Notes, 129).† (AS)

G3056.strongs: something said (including the thought); by implication, a topic (subject of discourse), also reasoning (the mental faculty) or motive; by extension, a computation; specially, (with the article in John) the Divine Expression (i.e. Christ)
G3056.kjv: account, cause, communication, X concerning, doctrine, fame, X have to do, intent, matter, mouth, preaching, question, reason, + reckon, remove, say(-ing), shew, X speaker, speech, talk, thing, + none of these things move me, tidings, treatise, utterance, word, work
